claims.quote: Psychology will be based on a new foundation, that of the necessary acquirement of each mental power and capacity by gradation.
claims.scope: mental powers of animals, including man
measurable_quantities: distribution of cognitive abilities across related species
phylogenetic signal in cognitive traits
claims.candidate_data: Comparative cognition datasets across primates and other animals (e.g. ManyPrimates), mapped on Open Tree of Life phylogenies.

claims.section: Concluding remarks
claims.label: Few living species will leave descendants; common species of dominant groups will prevail
claims.claim: Very few living species will leave descendants in the far future, and those that will prevail and give rise to new dominant species will be the common, widespread species of the larger, dominant groups.
claims.quote: We can so far take a prophetic glance into futurity as to foretel that it will be the common and widely-spread species, belonging to the larger and dominant groups, which will ultimately prevail and procreate new and dominant species.
claims.scope: living species and their future descendants (testable retrospectively in the fossil record)
measurable_quantities: survival and origination probability versus geographic range size and abundance
survival versus size of the higher group
claims.candidate_data: Paleobiology Database occurrence data to relate past range size and clade size to lineage survival and production of daughter taxa.

claims.section: Concluding remarks
claims.label: Succession by generation has never been broken by a world-wide cataclysm
claims.claim: Since all living forms are lineal descendants of forms that lived long before the Silurian epoch, the ordinary succession by generation has never once been broken and no cataclysm has ever desolated the whole world.
claims.quote: As all the living forms of life are the lineal descendants of those which lived long before the Silurian epoch, we may feel certain that the ordinary succession by generation has never once been broken, and that no cataclysm has desolated the whole world.
claims.scope: the history of life on earth
measurable_quantities: continuity of lineages across mass-extinction boundaries
proportion of lineages surviving each extinction event
claims.candidate_data: Paleobiology Database records across mass-extinction boundaries and dated phylogenies (TimeTree) showing lineages crossing them.

claims.section: Concluding remarks
claims.label: Natural selection makes endowments tend towards perfection
claims.claim: Because natural selection works solely by and for the good of each being, all bodily and mental endowments will tend to progress towards perfection.
claims.quote: And as natural selection works solely by and for the good of each being, all corporeal and mental endowments will tend to progress towards perfection.
claims.scope: all organisms over long periods
measurable_quantities: long-term trends in measures of adaptation or fitness
claims.candidate_data: Long-term experimental evolution of fitness (LTEE) and long-run fossil trends in the Paleobiology Database bear on part of the claim.

claims.section: Concluding remarks
claims.label: The 'entangled bank' laws produce the diversity of living forms
claims.claim: The varied and interdependent forms of life were produced by laws still acting: growth with reproduction; inheritance; variability caused by external conditions and by use and disuse; a rate of increase high enough to cause a struggle for life and so natural selection, which in turn causes divergence of character and extinction of less improved forms.
claims.quote: These laws, taken in the largest sense, being Growth with Reproduction; Inheritance which is almost implied by reproduction; Variability from the indirect and direct action of the external conditions of life, and from use and disuse; a Ratio of Increase so high as to lead to a Struggle for Life, and as a consequence to Natural Selection, entailing Divergence of Character and the Extinction of less-improved forms.
claims.scope: all organic beings
measurable_quantities: heritability of traits
standing variation
reproductive excess and mortality
selection differentials
rates of divergence and extinction
claims.candidate_data: Experimental-evolution datasets (LTEE, Dryad), long-term wild-population studies, and Paleobiology Database diversification data each address components of the claim.
